title: PATS-70A Power Board Repairs
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8222  AFSC OL H PZIE
description_text: This action is to purchase a service peculiar to one manufacturer, a single source procurement of Marvin Test Solutions, Inc. (MTS) MTS-207 power board repair. This service is needed to support the 516th Software Engineering Squadron’s (516 SWES) sustainment of Portable Automated Test Set-70A (PATS-70A) testers and components for the Air Force.
